WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
BRIEF   01 / 19
Wishfire Idle-Stage
Migration Atlas
A visual systems guide for moving from turn-based party combat to a
G123-flavored, Legend-style real-time idle RPG.
PLANNING ONLY
EVIDENCE CHECKED
360 X 640 TARGET
The product shift in one sentence
Move player decisions out of turn-by-turn attacks and into party builds,
gear choices, automatic skill priorities, stage attempts, and long-horizon
progression while combat runs continuously.
Keep Wishfire identity: four-hero party, readable VFX, quest structure, gear, and browser
delivery.
Build the new authority: waves, bosses, cooldowns, lamps, idle rewards, and durable claims.
REFERENCE LOOP
CURRENT FOUNDATION

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
DECISION FRAME   02 / 19
PRODUCT SCOPE
What “clone” means here
Copy the proven system grammar. Preserve Wishfire’s setting, party identity, and readable combat presentation.
KEEP
Four-hero party
Browser-first 360 x 640 shell
Quest and chapter identity
Readable VFX and damage cadence
Equipment slots, rarity, CP
REARRANGE
Player agency moves to builds
Combat becomes continuous
Session card choices become presets
Bosses gate stage progress
Loot decisions sit on main screen
ADD
Lamp reward loop
Wave and boss authority
Real-time actor cooldowns
Offline reward ledger
Dailies and one event layer
DEFER UNTIL THE CORE LOOP EARNS IT
Guilds, cross-server competition, ad rewards, paid gacha, battle passes, and multiple event currencies require identity, telemetry, server authority, and
economic controls.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
REFERENCE ANATOMY   03 / 19
OBSERVED REFERENCE
Why the reference screen works
The battle keeps moving while the player makes progression decisions around it. The screen is a loop controller, not a spectator window.
1
Stage, resources, and boss gate
2
Continuous combat stays visible
3
Auto skills fire without prompts
4
Gear compare: equip or sell
5
Lamp remains the repeat action
LOOP PRINCIPLE
Motion
Combat never waits for a menu decision.
Decision
Loot asks one fast question: stronger or currency?
Progress
Stage and boss results unlock better rewards.
Return
Offline gains create a reason to reopen.
Breadth
Side systems deepen the same power goal.
Source: Legend of Mushroom gameplay screenshot [S2/S4].

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
DELIVERY FLAVOR   04 / 19
PLATFORM TARGET
Aim for the G123 delivery model
Instant browser access, compact party combat, fast returning sessions, and many systems routed through one stage screen.
WISHFIRE INTERPRETATION
01  Instant entry
Playable before account commitment; recovery and linking can follow.
02  Compact party
Keep four heroes visible, with automated skills and small formation offsets.
03  Short return loop
Claim, lamp, compare, upgrade, boss attempt, leave.
04  Cross-device shape
The current 360 x 640 logical viewport already fits the delivery goal.
Sources: G123 official promotion and platform materials [S5-S7]; user-provided combat reference.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
CURRENT STATE   05 / 19
CURRENT MERGED MAIN
Wishfire already has the outer shell
The new product should reuse the proven shell and data while replacing the turn authority at the center.
FOUNDATION AUDIT
REUSE
360 x 640 shell and nav
REUSE
4 heroes, kits, EXP
REUSE
6 gear slots, 5 rarities
REUSE
market, save, CP math
ADAPT
quest ladder into stages
ADAPT
VFX into cooldown cadence
REPLACE
explicit actor turn loop
REPLACE
session card interruptions
BUILD
lamp and offline ledger
CURRENT MAP / HOME
CURRENT INTERRUPTIVE COMBAT

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
CORE LOOP   06 / 19
TARGET PRODUCT LOOP
The loop to build first
Every added system must feed power, stage progress, or return motivation. The first proof needs only this closed circuit.
AUTO BATTLE
Heroes fight waves continuously.
BOSS GATE
Beat the boss to advance.
LAMP DROP
Stage rewards produce lamps.
ROLL GEAR
Reveal one item and compare.
EQUIP / SELL
Power up or convert to Gold.
GROW POWER
Gear, levels, skills, companions.
THE PLAYER’S JOB
Tune the build, accept or sell gear, claim
earned resources, choose a boss attempt, and
improve automatic actions.
COMBAT NEVER WAITS

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
COMBAT AUTHORITY   07 / 19
ARCHITECTURE
Real-time rules with readable presentation
Use one deterministic scheduler for combat truth and one presentation queue that prevents effects from piling up.
STAGE CLOCK
Fixed-step simulation. Wave and boss
state.
ACTOR CADENCE
Attack interval, skill cooldown, targeting.
RESOLUTION
Damage, heal, death, rewards, next
spawn.
PRESENTATION QUEUE
Impact, number, bar, removal. One readable package.
EXAMPLE: 1.2 SECOND HERO CADENCE
READY
0.00s
STRIKE
0.08s
IMPACT
0.20s
NUMBER
0.38s
BAR
0.55s
DEATH
0.72s
READY
1.20s
Rule: simulation may know the next event, but the visible package owns the stage until its minimum readability window completes. This preserves the combat clarity already proven in
Wishfire.
Upgrade path: animation event markers can replace fixed windows after the art pipeline matures.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
PLAYER AGENCY   08 / 19
INTERACTION MODEL
Move decisions before and between fights
Automation removes attack-by-attack selection. It must create stronger build decisions in exchange.
CURRENT TURN MODEL
TARGET IDLE-STAGE MODEL
1
Choose the acting hero
2
Choose attack / heal / card
3
Wait through a serialized action
4
Repeat each actor turn
5
Resolve session offer interruptions
1
Set three active skills per hero
2
Set target and ultimate priorities
3
Equip, sell, and level gear
4
Choose companions and one relic
5
Trigger boss attempts and claims
AGENCY MOVES TO BUILDCRAFT

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
SCREEN BLUEPRINT   09 / 19
SIZE, NOT CHARACTER APPEARANCE
360 x 640 proportional layout
Keep battle readable on a phone while the lamp decision remains reachable. These are starting ratios, not final art direction.
HUD / STAGE
9%
BATTLEFIELD
39%
PARTY / POWER
11%
LAMP + LOOT
27%
BOTTOM NAV
14%
PROPORTION STARTING POINTS
Hero height
48–64 px
20–26% of battlefield height
Enemy height
42–58 px
Boss: 72–96 px
Normal impact
0.55–0.90 x actor height
Large impact: up to 1.2 x
Touch target
44 px minimum
Primary lamp control: 68–84 px
Gear compare
1 item at a time
Two large actions: equip / sell
Visible currencies
3 in top HUD
Overflow opens the resource drawer
READABILITY RULE
At 360 px wide, simultaneous actors are silhouettes and state carriers. Detail belongs in hero, equipment,
and result screens.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
MIGRATION MATRIX   10 / 19
SCOPE MAP
Reuse, adapt, build, defer
This is the migration boundary. It prevents a rewrite of working foundations and blocks premature live-service scope.
REUSE
ADAPT
BUILD
DEFER
Responsive shell
Quest ladder
Stage authority
Guilds
Hero definitions
Hero commands
Cooldown scheduler
Cross-server
EXP progression
Action presentation
Lamp inventory
Ads / paid gacha
Equipment model
Market UI
Offline ledger
Battle pass
Save storage
VFX placement
Daily reset
Multi-event calendar
Combat power
Map / chapter UI
Auto skill presets
PvP seasons
Browser tests
Gallery shells
Reward audit trail
Backend social
“Gallery shells” means navigation/presentation exists; gameplay depth still must be implemented when promoted.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
PROGRESSION DEPTH   11 / 19
SYSTEM STACK
Build depth in layers, not all at once
A strong idle RPG compounds a few clear growth systems. Each layer earns a visible outcome in combat.
STAGE
Waves, boss gates,
chapters
first authority
PARTY
Levels, roles,
formation, presets
 existing + adapt
GEAR
Six slots, rarity, stats,
sell value
existing + lamp
SKILLS
Three actives,
cooldowns, ultimate
adapt current kits
COMPANIONS
Two passive/trigger
slots
new after core
META
One mount or relic
track
phase 4
LIVE OPS
Dailies, one event,
seasons
last
Power funnel
Every layer improves stage clear speed, boss survival, or reward access. A layer with no clear effect belongs outside the first migration.
CORE
LIVE SERVICE

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
ECONOMY   12 / 19
MINIMUM VIABLE WALLET
Start with five currencies
The reference genre can drown players in tokens. The alpha wallet should remain legible and auditable.
 G
GOLD
Gear upgrades and broad sinks
SOURCE: STAGE / SELL
L
LAMPS
Roll one equipment item
SOURCE: STAGE / BOSS
S
SKILL TOKENS
Upgrade automatic skills
SOURCE: DUNGEON / DAILY
C
COMPANION TOKENS
Acquire and grow companions
SOURCE: DUNGEON / EVENT
D
DUNGEON KEYS
Limit special reward runs
SOURCE: DAILY RESET
LATER, WITH SERVER AUTHORITY
Premium currency, paid lamps, ad claims, passes,
compensation mail, and event exchanges.
Add only after telemetry and fraud controls exist.
ANTI-INFLATION RULE
Every source needs a sink, a daily ceiling, and a single owner. Reward tables should identify source, amount, cap, and claim key.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
LAMP + GEAR   13 / 19
REWARD ENGINE
Turn the existing equipment model into the main reward loop
Wishfire already owns six slots, five rarities, equipment stats, purchases, persistence, and combat-power math.
1  EARN
Wave or boss grants lamps.
2  OPEN
Consume one lamp.
3  ROLL
Rarity + slot + affixes.
4  COMPARE
Show CP and stat delta.
5A  EQUIP
Replace item; recalc CP.
5B  SELL
Convert to Gold.
ROLL CONTRACT
INPUT
lampId, stageId, lampLevel, rollSeed
OUTPUT
equipmentId, rarity, slot, stats, sellValue
DECISION
equip / sell / hold one pending item
PERSISTENCE
atomic consume + result + decision
AUTOMATION
rarity floor, CP floor, slot filters
PROTECTION
idempotent claim and deterministic replay
Reference: lamp rarity odds and gear loop [S2-S4, S9].

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
AUTO-COMBAT BUILD   14 / 19
WISHFIRE-SPECIFIC ADVANTAGE
Keep the party; automate the kit
The target differs from a one-avatar clone: four heroes remain the strategic object.
 F
FARA
TANK
taunt > guard > strike
H
HONDO
FIGHTER
lowest HP > front enemy
R
RUNA
CONTROL
cluster > debuff > burst
K
KAJA
SUPPORT
heal threshold > buff > attack
FIRST AUTO-BUILD SURFACE
3 ACTIVE SKILLS
Current action slots become
cooldown-equipped skills.
1 ULTIMATE
FLOW becomes an automatic ultimate with a
condition.
2 COMPANIONS
One passive aura and one triggered helper.
4 PRIORITIES
Target, heal threshold, ultimate condition,
boss mode.
NO MID-FIGHT MENU REQUIRED

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
RETURN LOOP   15 / 19
PERSISTENCE + LIVE OPS
Offline rewards must behave like a bank ledger
The client may display elapsed time. Reward truth needs deterministic, idempotent settlement.
SESSION CLOSE
Store stage, power snapshot, server time.
ELAPSED WINDOW
Clamp duration; exclude paused or invalid
time.
REWARD CALC
Rate x eligible time with caps.
ATOMIC CLAIM
One claim key; commit once.
DAILY RHYTHM
Claim capped idle chest
Spend lamps and compare gear
Run one skill or companion dungeon
Attempt the current boss
Collect one daily milestone
SERVER BOUNDARY
Authoritative time and claim keys
Inventory mutation and purchase receipts
Daily reset and event windows
Mailbox / compensation
Guild, ranking, PvP, cross-server
Prototype may run locally; production settlement should move to server authority before monetized rewards.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
TECHNICAL OWNERSHIP   16 / 19
MODULE MAP
Put each rule in one home
Keep the browser shell thin. Deterministic rules remain testable without the rendered game.
CONTENT
heroes, enemies, stages, drops
existing data + new tables
RULES
cadence, targeting, damage, loot
shared deterministic core
SESSION
wave state, boss gate, claims
new stage authority
PRESENTATION
sprites, VFX, numbers, UI
adapt current queue
PERSISTENCE
save, inventory, receipts
extend storage; add ledger
OWNERSHIP TEST
Given the same seed and commands, RULES + SESSION must reproduce the same result without DOM, timers, or images. PRESENTATION may lag, but it cannot
change combat truth.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
MIGRATION ROADMAP   17 / 19
IMPLEMENTATION ORDER
Six gated phases
Each phase ends with a playable proof. Stop when evidence fails; breadth does not rescue a broken core loop.
P0
CONTRACT
Write state model, timing rules,
reward tables, save migration.
P1
STAGE PROOF
1-1 waves > boss > 1-2; four
heroes auto-fight.
P2
LAMP PROOF
Drop, roll, compare, equip/sell, CP
update, persistence.
P3
RETURN PROOF
Capped offline claim, daily reset,
deterministic replay.
P4
DEPTH PROOF
Automatic skills, two companions,
one meta track.
P5
SERVICE PROOF
One event;
identity/backend/telemetry
decision.
P2 IS THE FIRST GO / NO-GO MILESTONE
1
A party clears a full stage without player attack input.
2
At least one enemy drops a lamp.
3
Opening it produces one auditable gear roll.
4
Equip or sell changes persistent state and combat power.
5
Reload restores the exact stage, party, and inventory.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
EVIDENCE GATES   18 / 19
QA PLAN
How we know the migration works
Runtime proof should show human-readable combat, deterministic rules, durable claims, and stable phone-scale layout.
 LOOP
Watch 1-1 > boss > 1-2 without intervention.
VIDEO + STATE LOG
CADENCE
No VFX, damage number, death, or spawn overlaps incorrectly.
TIMELINE ASSERTIONS
LOOT
Same seed yields same lamp item; equip/sell commits once.
REPLAY TEST
OFFLINE
Clock changes cannot duplicate a claim; cap is visible.
LEDGER TEST
SAVE
Reload and second tab preserve one inventory truth.
PERSISTENCE TEST
SCALE
360 x 640 and compact 216 x 384 remain readable.
SCREENSHOTS
RELEASE BLOCKER
Any duplicate reward, resurrected target, interrupted visual package, or invisible stage transition blocks the milestone.

WISHFIRE  /  LEGEND-STYLE IDLE STAGE STUDY
SOURCES + DECISIONS   19 / 19
HANDOFF
Evidence and open decisions
Primary sources establish the product grammar; secondary guides fill version-sensitive loop details. Recommendations remain Wishfire-specific.

DECISIONS BEFORE P0
1
Battle speed target
Choose 1x cadence and maximum simultaneous packages.
2
Stage structure
Define waves per stage and boss-failure behavior.
3
Lamp cadence
Set drop rate, storage cap, and rarity curve.
4
Gear comparison
Choose CP weighting and stat exception rules.
5
Offline cap
Choose eligible hours and stage-based reward rate.
6
First meta layer
Pick companions, mount, or relic; ship one.
7
Backend point
Decide when local proof hands off to server authority.
RECOMMENDED START
Approve P0 only: write the state contract, timing budget,
reward tables, and save migration before changing runtime
code.
